post.summary: API login. Obtain JWT accessToken and refreshToken.
post.description:
The API uses JSON Web Tokens for authentication. See https://jwt.io/introduction/ for documentation.

Default username / password is api / steute_api .
You may change the password in the web UI user settings menu.

Authentication within this Swagger UI

  1. Use the "Try it out" feature of auth/login to submit username/password and obtain an accessToken.
  2. Copy the entire accessToken string (without qoutation marks)
  3. Click on the green "Autorize" button in the upper right of this page.
  4. Insert the accessToken String into the "bearer (apiKey)" Value field. Press "Authorize" to save it.
  5. Now you are authorized for 30 minutes. Use the "Try it out" feature to explore the API.

200.description:
successful operation
Returns an accessToken, valid for 30 minutes and a refreshToken, valid for 180 minutes.

200.description:
successful operation
Returns an accessToken, valid for 30 minutes and a refreshToken, valid for 180 minutes.

info.title: Sensor Bridge API Version 2
info.description:
steute sWave.NET Sensor Bridge API v2

  • Get status information of access points and switches.
  • Configure groups, device parameters and notifications.

id.description: Group id. (assigned by system upon creation)

name.description: Name of the configuration group. (required, max. 64 chars)

description.example: Tiling sensor configuration for rack B5 (chassis mounting)
description.description: Description for the group provided by th user. (max. 256 chars)

wakeupHours.description: Set cyclic wakeup time to n hours (0-15).

wakeupMin.description: Set cyclic wakeup time to n minutes (0-15).

cycletimeFactor125ms.description: Min. time between transmitting two switch events. n times 125 ms (0 - 255)

debouncetimeFactor125ms.description: Min. time switch state must have changed before radio transmission. n times 125 ms (0 - 255)

useCycletimeRF96.description: Determines if RF 96 and RF IO types use cycletime (true) oder debouncetime (false).

rwAngle.description: Roller conveyor angle for RF RW tilting sensor. (-27 to 90 degrees)

rwLedDisabled.description: If set to true, LED in RF RW will be disabled.

isManaged.description: Only if set to true, parameters for members of this group will be provided to access points.

isStandard.description: If set to true, each new detected switch will be assigned to this group (Will only apply to one group).

isInvisible.description: If set to true, unmanaged groups are hidden in 'sensors & actors' overview

sdsThresholdDist.description: RF 96 SDS: Threshold for switching on/off in cm.

sdsHysteresis.description: RF 96 SDS: Switching hysteresis in cm.

sdsDebounce.description: RF 96 SDS: Timing interval of measurement (in seconds). Values under 4 lead to high battery consumption.

ldsThresholdDist.description: RF 96 LDS: Threshold for switching on/off in cm.

ldsHysteresis.description: RF 96 LDS: Switching hysteresis in cm.

ldsDebounce.description: RF 96 LDS: Timing interval of measurement (in seconds). Values under 4 lead to high battery consumption.

actuationNumber.description: RF DSENS: Define the count of act to send a telegramm to the Sensor Bridge.

actuationTimeout.description: RF DSENS: Time span in seconds until the next actuation must take place, otherwise the internal actuation counter is reset.

name.description: Name of the notification as provided by the user. (max. 64 chars)

urlString.description: Target URL to which the notification will be send. (without "http(s)://", max. 1024 chars)

description.example: Sends switch event data to my application.
description.description: Optional description provided by the user. (max. 256 chars)

isEnabled.description: If set, switch events and missing wakeups will trigger this notification.

isEnabledNotManaged.description: If set, switch events and missing wakeups will trigger this notification, even if the group of the switch is not managed.

noWakeups.description: If set, wakeup messages will no longer trigger this notification

notificationSendState.description: Determines on which state, on/off, the notification will be sent "STATE_ALL" = on/off, "STATE_OFF" = off , STATE_ON = on

useTls.description: Protocol used: false = HTTP,  true = HTTPS (without certificate validation)

responseTimeout.description: Time to wait for a server response. (1 - 300 seconds)
